description: The image behind hint MDEF, Patrick Flynn's 1908 death certificate. It settles both index discrepancies in the tree's favour: death 12 March 1908, father Thomas Flynn. Keyed on `ark` (search-hints passes the record's imageArk as `ark`, not `imageId`), so image-transcribe-any, keyed on imageId, never shadows it (issue #2029).

response.transcription:
COMMONWEALTH OF PENNSYLVANIA. DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH. CERTIFICATE OF DEATH. File No. 4521.
Place of death: County of Schuylkill, Borough of Pottsville.
Full name: Patrick Flynn.
Sex: Male. Color: White. Single, married, widowed: Married.
Date of birth: about 1845. Age: 63 yrs.
Birthplace: Ireland.
Name of father: Thomas Flynn.
Birthplace of father: Ireland.
Maiden name of mother: [illegible].
Informant: James Brown, Pottsville.
Date of death: March 12, 1908.
Cause of death: Miner's asthma.
Place of burial: St. Patrick's Cemetery. Date of burial: March 15, 1908.
